- If sentiment is positive (≥0.17) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- If sentiment is negative (≤-0.28), model often overcorrects downward; avoid sharp dips; consider slight upward bias.
- Model frequently overshoots after recent spikes (e.g., +70→+73); cap forecast at 1–2% above peak in 3–5 day window.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3–5 day average is below 70.5, model often overpredicts; adjust downward by 0.5–1.5 points.
- For 30-day horizon, model tends to overestimate late-period (last 10 days) prices; reduce final 5–7 days by 0.5–1.5 points.
- If sentiment is volatile (alternating +/–), model exhibits erratic behavior; smooth forecast with weighted average of 3–5 prior days.
